plants.name: Drosera capensis
plants.tip: Rainwater or distilled only. Tap water kills it within weeks. Stand the pot in 2cm of water all year.
plants.colour: Green strap leaves with red tentacles and clear dew

plants.name: Drosera capensis 'Alba'
plants.tip: No red pigment at all, so judge the light by leaf size rather than colour. Rainwater only, tray topped up.
plants.colour: Uniformly pale green with clear dew and white flowers

plants.name: Drosera capensis (broad leaf)
plants.tip: Wider leaves hold more dew and catch more flies. Same care as the type: rainwater, permanent tray, full sun.
plants.colour: Broad green laminae with dense red tentacles

plants.name: Drosera capensis 'Bainskloof'
plants.tip: The narrow leaves colour deep red in strong sun. Rainwater only, and never let the tray run dry.
plants.colour: Narrow leaves flushing red, with red tentacles

plants.name: Drosera aliciae
plants.tip: Forms a tight rosette that reddens in full sun. Rainwater in the tray, and no fertiliser at the roots.
plants.colour: Flat green rosette flushing red, red-tipped tentacles

plants.name: Drosera spatulata
plants.tip: Self-seeds freely into neighbouring pots. Rainwater only, a permanent tray, and as much sun as you can give.
plants.colour: Small green spoon-shaped leaves with pink tentacles

plants.name: Drosera tokaiensis
plants.tip: A natural hybrid that is unusually forgiving of neglect. Rainwater, permanent tray, bright direct light.
plants.colour: Green spoon-shaped rosette with pink-red tentacles

plants.name: Drosera venusta
plants.tip: Colours almost black-red in full sun and stays plain green in shade. Rainwater only, tray kept topped up.
plants.colour: Green wedge leaves with deep red tentacles

plants.name: Drosera nidiformis
plants.tip: Leaves lengthen and arch as the plant ages, which is normal. Rainwater in a permanent tray, never fertilise.
plants.colour: Slim arching green leaves with red tentacles

plants.name: Drosera admirabilis
plants.tip: Old leaves persist as a black skirt under the rosette. Leave them alone. Rainwater only, permanent tray.
plants.colour: Small green rosette with red-tipped tentacles

plants.name: Drosera slackii
plants.tip: Slow but long-lived. Rainwater only, a permanent tray, and full sun to bring the red into the leaves.
plants.colour: Broad green rosette with red tentacles and red edges

plants.name: Drosera cuneifolia
plants.tip: The flat wedge leaves press to the soil. In weak light it stretches and pales instead. Rainwater only.
plants.colour: Flat green wedge leaves with red tentacles

plants.name: Drosera burmannii
plants.tip: An annual: let it flower and set seed rather than trying to keep the plant going. Rainwater, always wet.
plants.colour: Small green rosette turning red, with long snap tentacles

plants.name: Drosera indica
plants.tip: Annual, and it needs real heat to grow well. Sow fresh seed each spring. Rainwater only, tray kept full.
plants.colour: Thread-like green stems with pink glandular tentacles

plants.name: Drosera capillaris
plants.tip: Small and quick from seed. Rainwater in a permanent tray, full sun, and a cool winter rest.
plants.colour: Green rosette flushing red with pink tentacles

plants.name: Drosera binata
plants.tip: Dies back to the rootstock in winter. Do not throw it out; it returns in spring. Rainwater only.
plants.colour: Forked green leaves on tall stalks with red tentacles

plants.name: Drosera binata var. multifida 'Extrema'
plants.tip: The running roots need a deep pot. Rainwater only, permanent tray, full sun, and a winter dieback.
plants.colour: Repeatedly forked green leaves with red tentacles

plants.name: Drosera binata var. dichotoma 'Giant'
plants.tip: Leaves reach 40cm, so stake it or give it room. Rainwater in a deep tray; winter dieback is normal.
plants.colour: Large Y-forked green leaves with dense red tentacles

plants.name: Drosera 'Marston Dragon'
plants.tip: A vigorous forked cultivar that spreads by root. Rainwater only, a deep tray, and expect winter dormancy.
plants.colour: Tall multi-forked green leaves with red tentacles

plants.name: Drosera adelae
plants.tip: Scorches in direct sun and spreads by root runners. Bright indirect light, rainwater, always wet.
plants.colour: Long lance-shaped green leaves with red tentacles

plants.name: Drosera prolifera
plants.tip: Flower stalks arch over and root into plantlets. Peg them down. Warm, humid, rainwater, never dry.
plants.colour: Round green leaves on red petioles with red tentacles

plants.name: Drosera schizandra
plants.tip: The fussy one. Deep shade, high humidity and a permanently wet rainwater tray, or it collapses.
plants.colour: Broad paddle-shaped green leaves with short red tentacles

plants.name: Drosera madagascariensis
plants.tip: The stem lengthens and flops, so give it support. Rainwater in a permanent tray, warmth, and full sun.
plants.colour: Small green leaves on an upright stem with red tentacles

plants.name: Drosera regia
plants.tip: The largest sundew, and it resents heat at the roots. Keep it cool and bright, tray always full of rainwater.
plants.colour: Strap leaves to 40cm, green flushing red, red tentacles

plants.name: Drosera hamiltonii
plants.tip: Spreads slowly into a clump by root. Rainwater in a permanent tray, full sun, and no fertiliser.
plants.colour: Flat green rosette with red tentacles and pink flowers

plants.name: Drosera anglica
plants.tip: Needs a genuinely cold winter dormancy. An unheated windowsill or a cold frame, and rainwater only.
plants.colour: Upright narrow green leaves with red tentacles

plants.name: Drosera rotundifolia
plants.tip: Hardy, and it must have a cold winter to survive the next year. Live sphagnum, rainwater and full sun.
plants.colour: Round green leaves on flat petioles with red tentacles

plants.name: Drosera intermedia
plants.tip: Tolerates standing water better than most sundews. Rainwater tray year round, full sun, cold winter rest.
plants.colour: Upright green spoon leaves flushing red, red tentacles

plants.name: Drosera filiformis
plants.tip: Dies back to a winter bud. Keep the bud cold and wet, and cut the dead threads away in spring.
plants.colour: Upright green threads with red-purple tentacles

plants.name: Drosera filiformis var. tracyi
plants.tip: Taller and greener than the type, and it still needs a cold winter bud. Rainwater only, permanent tray.
plants.colour: Tall green threads with pale pink tentacles

plants.name: Drosera × obovata
plants.tip: A sterile hybrid, so increase it from leaf cuttings rather than seed. Cold winter dormancy, rainwater only.
plants.colour: Upright green spoon leaves with red tentacles

plants.name: Drosera petiolaris
plants.tip: Wants heat and humidity, and it sulks below 20°C. Rainwater, a warm shallow tray, and bright light.
plants.colour: Green rosette on hairy petioles with red tentacles

plants.name: Drosera falconeri
plants.tip: Needs a hot humid summer and a drier but still warm winter. Rainwater only, and never let it get cold.
plants.colour: Flat round green leaves flushing red, on short petioles

plants.name: Drosera lanata
plants.tip: Keep it hot and humid on rainwater, then cut the water right back for a warm winter rest.
plants.colour: Silver-woolly petioles with small red-tentacled leaves

plants.name: Drosera paradoxa
plants.tip: The most forgiving of the woolly sundews, but it still wants real heat. Rainwater, warm and humid.
plants.colour: Small green leaves on woolly petioles with red tentacles

plants.name: Drosera derbyensis
plants.tip: Woolly petioles and a need for constant warmth. Rainwater only, humid air, and drier through winter.
plants.colour: White-woolly petioles with round red-tentacled leaves

plants.name: Drosera scorpioides
plants.tip: Makes gemmae in autumn. Scatter them on damp peat to increase it. Rainwater only, shallow tray.
plants.colour: Silvery stem with green red-tentacled leaves in a rosette

plants.name: Drosera pulchella
plants.tip: Tiny, and the parent often fades after making gemmae. Collect and sow them in autumn to keep it going.
plants.colour: Flat green rosette with red tentacles and pink flowers

plants.name: Drosera roseana
plants.tip: A pygmy that needs a cool bright winter before it will set gemmae. Rainwater only and a shallow tray.
plants.colour: Green rosette with red tentacles and a silver central bud

plants.name: Drosera peltata
plants.tip: Grows from a tuber in winter and dies back in summer. Keep it bone dry until autumn or the tuber rots.
plants.colour: Shield-shaped green leaves on a wiry stem, red tentacles
